row.notes: Builds the solver hinge descriptor from a hinge config. Rotates the local axis cfg+0x50..+0x58 by body A's matrix (cfg+8 -> +0x18 -> +0x190), normalises it, derives two perpendicular basis vectors, optionally rotates the frame about the axis by angle cfg+0x60, and writes: bodies out+0/+8, body matrix out+0x80 with pivot cfg+0x20 at out+0xb0, frame A out+0xc0..+0xe0, frame B out+0x100..+0x120 (pre-rotated by the limit midpoint), half range (cfg+0x74 - cfg+0x70)/2 at out+0x144, cfg+0x80 at out+0x148, cfg+0x78 at out+0x14c, cfg+0x7c at out+0x150. Hook here to change hinge limits before the constraint is created.
